gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading books to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: A professional photographer took the couple's portraits.
gaps.sentence: The couple ___ by a professional photographer.
gaps.explanation: Arranging for a professional to do it: had their portraits taken.

gaps.lead: Somebody needs to renew this passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.
